description: Category 1 (numerical) questions with integer answers, authored from the challenge sample questions and reference images in questions/office_2/questions.pdf. Objects are restricted to salient, visually verifiable furniture and decor so a human can confirm every answer from the scene. Each question carries a machine-readable spec that scripts/eval/verify_benchmark2.py re-evaluates against the iref_vla object bounding boxes.
notes: Q01 is the official Category 1 sample question from questions/office_2/questions.pdf; its answer (1) is the answer printed in the PDF.
difficulty: easy = single salient object class; medium = one relation; hard = two chained relations.
office_2 is a single open-plan room (one iref region), so no question needs a region restriction.
The two desks are never named directly: one is identified by the laptop on it and the other by the water bottle on it, matching the phrasing style of the sample questions.

Windows and folders are not used as count targets: iref annotates each of the four windows twice (an upper and a lower pane) and annotates only some of the binder rows on the credenza, so neither number matches what a human would count.
Q02, Q09 and Q10 are deliberately paired: the four chairs split two and two between the desks.
object_ids lists supporting iref_vla scene-graph ids for auditing; SAM3 should use target_objects.

questions.question: How many potted plants are on a table?
questions.evidence: Only potted plant 110 stands on a desk (table 25); of the other two, 30 sits on the coffee counter cabinet and 12 is the large floor plant by the window.

questions.question: How many chairs are in the office?
questions.evidence: Four black office chairs (90, 146, 148, 157), two at each of the two desks.

questions.question: How many computer monitors are in the office?
questions.evidence: Three monitors: 141 and 151 on the desk by the windows and 75 on the desk with the laptop.

questions.question: How many keyboards are on the desks?
questions.evidence: Three keyboards (13, 143, 144) lie on the two desks, one per monitor.

questions.question: How many computer mice are on the desks?
questions.evidence: Four mice (3, 145, 149, 153) rest on purple mouse pads, two on each desk.

questions.question: How many cardboard boxes are on the cabinets below the whiteboard?
questions.evidence: Two brown boxes (36, 42) stand side by side on the wooden credenza (cabinets 56 and 160) under the whiteboard, next to the row of binders.

questions.question: How many markers are on the coffee counter?
questions.evidence: Three markers (47, 48, 49) lie on cabinet 155, the counter beside the coffee machine; no other marker in the office rests on a cabinet.

questions.question: How many coffee cups are on the desks?
questions.evidence: Two cups sit on desks: white mug 92 on the desk with the laptop and paper cup 140 on the desk by the windows. The other cups are at the coffee counter.

questions.question: How many chairs are at the desk with the water bottle on it?
questions.evidence: Water bottle 97 stands on desk 8 by the windows, which has chairs 148 and 157 at it; the other two chairs belong to the second desk.

questions.question: How many chairs are at the desk with the laptop on it?
questions.evidence: Laptop 102 is open on desk 25, which has chairs 90 and 146 at it; the other two chairs belong to the desk by the windows.
